name: Amakawa Yuu
source:
Hobbies: Listening to music
Likes: Family, friends, and co-workers.

A boy whose name is well known among those who fight Variants

He considers living as a Disobeyer to be the main focus of his life and goes to school only because people around him recommend him to. He enjoys simply being a student only when that leads to interact with [url=https://vndb.org/c50518]Chiharu[/url].

In the course of forming combat methods against Variants, he has assimilated much knowledge on martial arts. 

[From the Official Artbook]
